title: Razorwire policy
description: Rules that decide what happens to a tool call before it executes. Rules are evaluated top to bottom and the first match wins.

mode.description: enforce: decisions are applied. shadow: decisions are logged and every call is allowed through.

default.description: Decision for a tool call that no rule matches.

id.description: Stable identifier. Appears in the audit log next to every decision this rule makes.

match.description: Which tool calls this rule applies to.

tool.description: Tool name. `*` matches any run of characters, so `db_*` matches `db_query` and `db_drop`.

agent.description: Optional agent name, as sent in the `x-agent-name` header, same wildcard rules. Omit to match every agent.

when.description: Optional CEL expression that must be true for the rule to fire. `args` is the tool call's arguments, `agent` is the name sent in the `x-agent-name` header, and `run` counts what already happened in this run, read from the conversation the agent sent: `run.calls`, `run.same_tool`, `run.repeats`, `run.streak` and `run.blocked`. Omit to fire on every matched call. If the expression cannot be evaluated for a matched call, the call is blocked.

action.description: allow: run it. deny: block it and return `message` to the agent. review: hold it for a human. Until an approval flow exists, review blocks the call like deny.

message.description: Returned to the agent and written to the audit log when the rule denies or holds a call.
